text: With the same data and best-of-5 controls, the accel_step control R2 differs across seeds by about 0.06 (0.709-0.769), while the within-run control_spread is only 0.010-0.019. Does the control seed or probe split differ by run seed? Would a control pool shared across all seeds, or a control_spread taken across run seeds, give a fairer required_margin for comparing formation steps across N?
